sources.title: LFM2.5-230M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-230M is Liquid AI's smallest LFM2.5 text model, designed for edge devices with the tightest memory and compute budgets. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture, it is tuned for data extraction and lightweight on-device agentic tasks such as tool calling. It is not recommended for reasoning-heavy workloads like advanced math, code generation, or creative writing ...

sources.snippet: This makes LFM2.5-230M an ideal solution to power large-scale data extraction pipelines or lightweight on-device agentic workloads. However, given its compact size, we do not recommend it for reasoning-heavy workloads such as advanced math, code generation, or creative writing.
